title: AlphaDiana: A Measurement System for Agents in Verifiable Reasoning Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.20675v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents pair reasoning models with harnesses that organize model calls, execute tools, load skill instructions, and retain history in memory. Understanding agent performance requires linking execution conditions to outcomes, behavior, and resource use. We introduce AlphaDiana, a measurement system with modular interfaces for datasets, agents, environments, and scorers. It preserves harness-native control loops while controlling file reuse and memory retention separately. AlphaDiana supports macro analyses of complete agents and micro interventions on agent components such as tools, skills, and memory under matched conditions. We study three open-source models and three open-source harnesses on five answer-based benchmarks, with two models also tested on two interactive benchmarks. We find that harnesses do not consistently improve the accuracy of reasoning: gains on questions unsolved by the model alone can be outweighed by losses on ques

translated_title: AlphaDiana：面向可验证推理任务中智能体的测量系统
translated_abstract: 智能体将推理模型与脚手架（harness）相结合，脚手架负责组织模型调用、执行工具、加载技能指令，并在内存中保留历史记录。理解智能体性能需要将执行条件与结果、行为和资源使用联系起来。我们推出了AlphaDiana，这是一个为数据集、智能体、环境和评分器提供模块化接口的测量系统。它在保留脚手架原生控制循环的同时，将文件重用和记忆保留的控制相互分离。AlphaDiana既支持对完整智能体进行宏观分析，也支持在匹配条件下对工具、技能和记忆等智能体组件进行微观干预。我们在五个基于答案的基准测试上研究了三个开源模型和三个开源脚手架，其中两个模型还在两个交互式基准上进行了测试。我们发现，脚手架并不能持续提升推理准确性：在模型单独无法解决的问题上所获得的收益，可能会被在其他问题上的损失所抵消
tldr: AlphaDiana是一个面向可验证推理任务的模块化智能体测量系统，能够在匹配条件下对完整智能体进行宏观分析并对工具、技能、记忆等组件进行微观干预，研究发现脚手架并不能持续提升模型推理准确性。
en_tdlr: AlphaDiana is a modular measurement system for agents in verifiable reasoning tasks that supports both macro analyses of complete agents and micro interventions on components such as tools, skills, and memory, revealing that harnesses do not consistently improve reasoning accuracy.
